scientific.integrity: The defining primary paper was materially inspected through its definition, fractional-transversal reduction, and regular-pentagon proof. A recent full-text treatment and targeted semantic, exact-formula, and equivalent cyclic-interval searches were compared against the claim. The proof is exact; finite computation is used only as a regression check.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to convex equiangular polygons and does not determine the invariant for arbitrary polygons.
The regular-pentagon lower bound 5/2 is prior work; the new content is sharpness, the all-n equiangular formula, and the equality conditions.
The proof is elementary after reduction to a cyclic interval system, leaving a residual risk of an unindexed equivalent observation.

title: Exact fractional illumination of every equiangular polygon
